title: Agnus Dei (Victoria, Missa O quam gloriosam)
desc: Tomás Luis de Victoria, Missa O quam gloriosam, Agnus Dei. 4 voices (Cantus, Alto, Tenor, Bass), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0042_5); edited by Brian Marble, Michael Winter, Vincent Besson. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
